reasoning: The landscape plan shows proposed trees along the southern property boundary immediately adjacent to an overhead electric (OHE) line marked on the electrical and landscape plans. Trees include proposed mitigation trees (marked 'M'), and per the plant schedule, these consist of Cedar Elm (90 ft mature height - NOT utility-compatible), Live Oak (60 ft - NOT utility-compatible), and utility-compatible smaller trees (Mexican Redbud, Texas Mountain Laurel). The OHE line appears to represent distribution-level utility service. Required clearances per UCM § 1.10.10.4 are: 15 lateral feet minimum for non-utility-compatible trees from distribution conductor, and 25 feet minimum for large trees (40+ ft mature height).
